descriptionChirho: The proper noun Mahanaim, a town in Gilead east of the Jordan, associated with Jacob's encounter with angels (Gen 32:2) and later a Levitical city and royal refuge. All four clusters represent the same toponym with different prepositional constructions: to/at Mahanaim (eng: to-Mahanaim, spa: Majanayim, arb: مَحَنَايِمَ, kor: 마하나임으로, swa: Mahanaimu), from Mahanaim (eng: from-Mahanaim, arb: مِنْ–مَحَنَايِمَ), and in Mahanaim (eng: in-Mahanaim, hin: महनैम–में). The Arabic consistently renders مَحَنَايِمَ, Korean 마하나임, and Swahili Mahanaimu across all clusters, confirming a single referent with purely grammatical variation in prepositional framing.
